_note: The two pairs REPEAT_THRESHOLD has to separate. `same` is the same claim in different words and must read as a repeat; `different` shares a domain and a vocabulary but makes a different claim, and must not. Design.md D3 starts the threshold at 0.92 on Voyage 3.5 and says these pairs are what set it — so the cosine half of the test needs VOYAGE_API_KEY and is skipped without one. The text-equality half always runs.

pairs.label: same
pairs.note: One founder, one capability, two turns' worth of wording.
pairs.a: ran dental procurement for four years
pairs.b: spent four years running procurement for dental practices

pairs.label: different
pairs.note: Same domain, same nouns, a different claim — procurement is not scheduling.
pairs.a: ran dental procurement for four years
pairs.b: built scheduling software for dental practices

equal.note: Normalization is the contract's: NFC, invisibles out, whitespace collapsed. Case is ours.
